import asyncio
import os
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8686"
API_KEY = $SECRET"CLOUD_API_KEY"]
URL = "https://jll.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/jllcareers/job/Creve-Coeur-MO/Specialist--HVAC-Technician_REQ495034"
OUT = Path("/tmp/opencode/stream_full.jsonl")


async def main() -> None:
    payload = {
        "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "url": URL,
        "executor_backend": "playwright",
        "execution_host": "local",
        "controls": [],
        "profile_data": {},
        "debug_enabled": True,
    }
    headers = {"X-API-Key": API_KEY, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    lines: list[str] = []
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
        async with client.stream(
            "POST", f"{BASE}/api/agent/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
        ) as response:
            print("HTTP", response.status_code)
            async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                if line:
                    lines.append(line)
    OUT.write_text("\n".join(lines))
    print("captured", len(lines), "lines")


asyncio.run(main())
